title: Upskill
summary: An enterprise-grade AI learning platform that integrates directly into team workflows via Slack and Google Workspace — autonomously detecting skill gaps and generating personalized learning interventions using a dual-model pipeline (Llama 4 + GPT-5) on Microsoft Azure Foundry.

description.problem: Professional development is disconnected from daily work output — skill gaps are self-reported through surveys, spotted late, and addressed with generic training that ignores what people actually do all day.
description.decision: Built an enterprise SaaS platform that ingests work artifacts from Slack and Google Workspace and runs a dual-model pipeline on Microsoft Azure Foundry: Llama 4 analyses artifacts across its 10M token context window to detect objective skill mastery, and GPT-5 synthesises those insights into personalised learning interventions. FastAPI backend with async analysis pipelines and Pydantic validation; Next.js dashboard with a hook-based real-time data layer.
description.impact: Zero-friction skill tracking with no manual input, high-fidelity diagnostics that surface gaps traditional analytics miss, and just-in-time learning delivered the moment a gap is detected — with enterprise PII protection and content filtering applied before analysis.

title: LuminaLLM
summary: A modular fine-tuning framework for adapting Llama 3 and Mistral to domain-specific tasks using QLoRA and PEFT. Achieves 75% VRAM reduction via 4-bit NF4 quantisation, enabling full training runs on a single consumer GPU. Ships with W&B experiment tracking and a benchmarking suite covering perplexity, ROUGE, and LLM-as-judge evaluation.

description.problem: Off-the-shelf LLMs underperform on domain-specific tasks, and traditional fine-tuning requires expensive high-VRAM hardware that's inaccessible for most practitioners.
description.decision: Built a modular QLoRA + PEFT fine-tuning framework for Llama 3 and Mistral, with 4-bit NF4 quantisation (75% VRAM reduction), Flash Attention 2, paged AdamW, and W&B experiment tracking. Supports Alpaca, ShareGPT, and OpenAI instruction formats out of the box.
description.impact: Enables full fine-tuning runs on a single consumer GPU. Ships with a benchmarking suite (perplexity, ROUGE, LLM-as-judge) and production merge/deployment scripts to take adapters straight to serving.

title: Nexus RAG
summary: An agentic, production-grade RAG system with hybrid retrieval (ChromaDB vector search + BM25) and cross-encoder re-ranking to cut hallucination rates on enterprise documentation. A LangGraph agent routes each query — answering from the internal knowledge base or falling back to GPT-4 / Claude 3.5 as needed.

description.problem: Single-vector search in RAG systems suffers poor recall on long-tail queries and high hallucination rates on enterprise documentation — making them unreliable for production use.
description.decision: Designed an agentic RAG pipeline using LangGraph, hybrid retrieval (ChromaDB vector search + BM25 keyword matching), and cross-encoder re-ranking. The agent decides whether to answer from the internal knowledge base or fall back to a general LLM response. Supports both OpenAI GPT-4 and Anthropic Claude 3.5.
description.impact: Production-ready system with multi-format ingestion (PDF, Markdown), FastAPI serving with validation and logging, and measurably fewer hallucinations through the re-ranking layer.

title: MLOps Sentinel
summary: A production-ready MLOps template covering the full model lifecycle — from automated training pipelines and model serialisation to a FastAPI inference layer, multi-stage Docker packaging, CI/CD via GitHub Actions, and real-time Prometheus metrics for latency and throughput observability.

description.problem: ML teams lack a standardised, observable framework for taking models from experiment to production — leading to inconsistent deployments and zero visibility into model behaviour in production.
description.decision: Built a complete MLOps reference implementation covering automated training pipelines, model serialisation, a production FastAPI inference layer, CI/CD via GitHub Actions, containerisation with multi-stage Docker, and real-time Prometheus metrics (latency, request volumes).
description.impact: End-to-end template for the full ML lifecycle in a containerised environment. Observability layer surfaces latency and throughput metrics for every inference request without additional instrumentation.
